rotation_token_normalization.double_prime_normalization: x2'/y2'/z2' normalize to x2/y2/z2 if emitted by parser

gauge_at_state_index: G is initialized at FB endpoint state. Moving forward across token j, first update G if token j is an explicit x/y/z rotation, then use the updated G for state j+1. Moving backward through FB for feature paths uses the exact inverse permutation of the frozen forward transport table.
prefix_initialization: At the ordinary FB endpoint, search 24 orientation representatives x 24 ordered Roux frames; admissible pair requires first block exactly solved and opposite block not solved. Exactly one pair is required.
sb_completion: First state from SB-span start through SB-span end where both locked blocks are exactly solved under the transported gauge.
rotation_present_stratum: At least one normalized x/y/z rotation token occurs from FB endpoint token index through SB completion-or-span-end inclusive.

feature_metric.objective_backtrack: For distances d_0..d_T, maintain running frontier=min_{s<=t} d_s and amplitude=max_t(d_t-frontier_before_or_at_t). Endpoint need not itself create a positive amplitude.
feature_metric.anchor_break_peak: max_t max(0, anchor_damage_t-anchor_damage_0) over the phase path.
feature_metric.distance: fraction of piece and orientation coordinates mismatching the frozen target over the phase-specific cubie mask
feature_metric.FB_target: default solved coordinates of the locked first 1x2x3 block
feature_metric.SB_target: default solved coordinates of the locked opposite 1x2x3 block
feature_metric.CMLL_target: transported endpoint corner configuration minimized over four AUF variants around the locked top face; both blocks are anchors
feature_metric.LSE_target: transported last LSE-span endpoint on the six non-block edges; both blocks are anchors

phase_spans.SB: first maximal contiguous ROUX_SB span after FB
phase_spans.CMLL: first nonempty ROUX_CMLL line after SB completion
phase_spans.LSE: first maximal contiguous ROUX_LSE span after SB completion

development_denominators.geometry_eligible: state-certified ordinary-FB routes with an SB span
development_denominators.rotation_present_completion_rate: completion among prefix-unique routes with >=1 post-FB pre-completion/span-end x/y/z token
development_denominators.no_rotation_completion_rate: completion among the complementary prefix-unique stratum
development_denominators.g3_admitted: prefix-unique routes with transported in-span two-block completion

post_result_change: Any change to transport, rotation classification, phase span, distance, amplitude, denominator or gate after G3 route results is a new remand/version, not an R1.13 repair.
